steps.name: Environment validation and optional global NODE_ENV persistence
steps.description: Validate node, npm and npx availability and minimum versions; create project-scoped .env.development if missing. Optionally persist NODE_ENV globally behind WRITE_GLOBAL_ENV=1; validate sudo presence before attempting /etc/profile.d writes and fail with clear message if permission fails. Operates in the workspace path provided.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98494/Database"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
command -v node >/dev/null || { echo "node missing" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "npm missing" >&2; exit 3; }
command -v npx >/dev/null || { echo "npx missing" >&2; exit 4; }
NODE_V=$(node -v | sed 's/^v//;s/[^0-9.].*$//')
NODE_MAJOR=${NODE_V%%.*}
if [ -z "$NODE_MAJOR" ] || [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 14 ]; then echo "node >=14 required, found $NODE_V" >&2; exit 5; fi
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/.env.development" ]; then
  cat > "$WORKSPACE/.env.development" <<'ENV'
# Project-scoped environment for development
NODE_ENV=development
# REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:3001
ENV
fi
export NODE_ENV=development
if [ "${WRITE_GLOBAL_ENV:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  command -v sudo >/dev/null || { echo "sudo not available to write /etc/profile.d; set WRITE_GLOBAL_ENV=0 or run as root" >&2; exit 21; }
  PROFILE_FILE=/etc/profile.d/react_env.sh
  TMPFILE="/tmp/react_env.sh.$$"
  cat > "$TMPFILE" <<'SH'
# persisted NODE_ENV for React dev (written by setup)
export NODE_ENV=development
SH
  if ! sudo bash -c "cmp -s '$TMPFILE' '$PROFILE_FILE' 2>/dev/null"; then
    if sudo cp "$TMPFILE" "$PROFILE_FILE" && sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE_FILE"; then :; else echo "failed to write $PROFILE_FILE" >&2; rm -f "$TMPFILE"; exit 22; fi
  fi
  rm -f "$TMPFILE"
fi
node -v && npm -v && npx --version
exit 0

steps.name: Scaffold fallback for permission-restricted filesystems
steps.description: Detect inability to change file modes or write helper scripts (common on read-only mounts). If detected, run create-react-app directly via inline bash -c invocation (no helper files) and provide clear remediation messages if the workspace is read-only. This step only runs when scaffold-001 may fail due to filesystem restrictions and ensures scaffolding can proceed without chmod. Operates in the workspace path.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98494/Database"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Quick writable check: try to create then remove a temp file
TMPF="$WORKSPACE/.write_test.$$"
if touch "$TMPF" 2>/dev/null; then rm -f "$TMPF"; else echo "workspace appears read-only or not writable: $WORKSPACE" >&2; exit 21; fi
# Ensure we can create files without needing chmod. Use inline npx invocation (no helper files)
if [ -f package.json ] && ( [ -f src/index.js ] || [ -f src/index.jsx ] || [ -f public/index.html ] ); then exit 0; fi
if [ -f package.json ] && ! ( [ -f src/index.js ] || [ -f public/index.html ] ); then echo "package.json exists but no CRA structure; skipping scaffold to avoid overwrite" >&2; exit 6; fi
TMPLOG=/tmp/cra_out.log
# prefer npx invocation which does not require writing executables
npx --yes create-react-app@latest . --use-npm >"$TMPLOG" 2>&1 || { sed -n '1,200p' "$TMPLOG" >&2; echo 'If this fails on a restrictive mount, provide a writable workspace or remount with write permissions' >&2; exit 22; }

exit 0

steps.description: Start react-scripts dev server with HOST=127.0.0.1, BROWSER=none, NODE_ENV=development in background, capture PID and logs, verify binding via curl. Fail fast if react-scripts missing. Operates in the workspace path.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98494/Database"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOG=/tmp/cra_start.log
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
HOST=${HOST:-127.0.0.1}
[ -f node_modules/react-scripts/package.json ] || { echo 'react-scripts not installed; run install-001' >&2; exit 12; }
NODE_ENV=development BROWSER=none HOST=$HOST PORT=$PORT npm start >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
echo "$PID" > /tmp/cra_start.pid
for i in {1..60}; do sleep 0.5; if curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi; done
if ! curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'dev server failed to start' >&2; kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 13; fi
tail -n 50 "$LOG" || true
exit 0

steps.name: Validation: build production bundle, serve, verify content, stop
steps.description: Build the app headless, verify build/index.html exists, serve the build using npx serve@latest or fallback to python3 -m http.server, verify HTTP 200 and expected page content, then stop server and provide evidence (build size and log snippet). Ensures react-scripts exists before build. Operates in the workspace path.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98494/Database"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f node_modules/react-scripts/package.json ] || { echo 'react-scripts missing; run install-001' >&2; exit 14; }
npm run build --silent || { echo 'build failed' >&2; exit 15; }
[ -f build/index.html ] || { echo 'build/index.html missing' >&2; exit 16; }
PORT=5000
LOG=/tmp/serve.log
# Prefer npx serve@latest; fallback to python static server
if npx --yes serve@latest -s build -l $PORT >"$LOG" 2>&1 & then
  PID=$!
else
  (cd build && python3 -m http.server $PORT) >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
  PID=$!
fi
cleanup(){ kill -TERM "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; kill -KILL "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true }
trap cleanup EXIT
for i in {1..60}; do sleep 0.5; if curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi; done
if ! curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" -o /tmp/served.html 2>/dev/null; then echo 'serve failed or no response' >&2; cleanup; exit 17; fi
if ! grep -q "Recipe Finder" /tmp/served.html; then echo 'unexpected page content' >&2; head -n 40 /tmp/served.html; cleanup; exit 18; fi
du -sh build | sed -n '1p'
head -n 40 "$LOG" || true
cleanup
trap - EXIT
exit 0
